bio: Pho House in Duluth is the ultimate come-as-you-are spot. Grab a seat, order and settle up at the register when you're finished. It's all very friendly and laidback, the perfect setting for a place that dishes out traditional Vietnamese comfort food. Familiar favorites range from pho and bánh mì to vermicelli bowls and fried rice, plus several vegetarian-friendly dishes. Of course, don't even think of skipping pho, and the combination with filet mignon, flank steak, brisket and a meatball is a hearty bowl that will feed your soul. You'll also never go wrong with the mi thit nuong bánh mì, a baguette tucked with chargrilled pork, ham, pâté and pickled veggies....
